```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,

  dpi = 150

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scam)
library(metR)
```

# Read and prepare the rule table

```{r read-data}
rules <- data.table::fread(
  "./inputs/aSMR_rules_test.csv"
) %>%
  mutate(
    SMRLevel = as.numeric(SMRLevel),
    CMD_range = as.numeric(CMD_range),
    aSMR = as.numeric(aSMR)
  )

rules_mod <- rules %>%
  filter(
    CMD_range < 9999,
    is.finite(SMRLevel),
    is.finite(CMD_range),
    is.finite(aSMR)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    SMRLevel,
    CMD_range
  )

dplyr::glimpse(rules_mod)

library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)

asmr_mod <- mgcv::gam(
  aSMR ~ te(
    SMRLevel,
    CMD_range,
    k = c(3, 8),
    bs = c("cr", "cr")
  ),
  data = rules_mod,
  method = "REML",
  gamma = 1.4
)

predict_aSMR <- function(rSMR, CMD) {

  pred <- predict(
    asmr_mod,
    newdata = data.frame(
      SMRLevel = rSMR,
      CMD_range = CMD
    ),
    type = "response"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  pmin(
    9,
    pmax(0, pred)
  )
}



surf_dat <- expand.grid(
  SMRLevel = seq(
    min(rules_mod$SMRLevel),
    max(rules_mod$SMRLevel),
    length.out = 201
  ),
  CMD_range = seq(
    0,
    min(1200, max(rules_mod$CMD_range)),
    length.out = 241
  )
)

predict_aSMR(
  rSMR = 5,
  CMD = 320
)


surf_dat$aSMR <- predict(
  asmr_mod,
  newdata = surf_dat,
  type = "response"
) %>%
  as.numeric()

surf_dat$aSMR <- pmin(
  9,
  pmax(0, surf_dat$aSMR)
)

library(ggplot2)
library(metR)

asmr_breaks <- seq(0, 9, by = 0.5)

ggplot(
  surf_dat,
  aes(
    x = SMRLevel,
    y = CMD_range,
    z = aSMR
  )
) +
  geom_contour_filled(
    breaks = asmr_breaks
  ) +
  geom_contour(
    breaks = asmr_breaks,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  metR::geom_text_contour(
    breaks = asmr_breaks,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1200, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative soil moisture regime (rSMR)",
    y = "Climatic moisture deficit (CMD)",
    fill = "aSMR",
    title = "Adjusted soil moisture regime by rSMR and CMD"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
estimate_aSMR <- function(CMD, model = asmr_mod) {

  # Create all rSMR classes
  out <- tibble(
    rSMR = 0:8,
    CMD = CMD
  ) %>%
    mutate(

      # Adjust climate CMD for site moisture regime
      CMD.adj = case_when(
        rSMR == 0 ~ CMD + 500,
        rSMR == 1 ~ CMD + 375,
        rSMR == 2 ~ CMD + 250,
        rSMR == 3 ~ CMD + 125,
        rSMR == 4 ~ CMD,
        rSMR == 5 ~ CMD / 2,
        rSMR == 6 ~ CMD / 4,
        rSMR == 7 ~ CMD / 8,
        rSMR == 8 ~ 0,
        TRUE      ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # Prevent negative CMD
      CMD.site = pmax(CMD.adj, 0)
    )

  # Predict aSMR using rSMR and site-adjusted CMD
  out$aSMR <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = data.frame(
      SMRLevel = out$rSMR,
      CMD_range = out$CMD.site
    ),
    type = "response"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # Keep aSMR within valid range
  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      aSMR = pmin(9, pmax(0, aSMR))
    )

  return(out)
}

estimate_aSMR(CMD = 550)
```


# Selected rule-table relationships

This plot shows the original rule-table values for selected relative soil moisture regimes.

```{r rule-table-plot}
rules_selected <- rules_mod %>%
  filter(
    SMRLevel %in% c(0, 5, 6, 7)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rSMR = factor(
      SMRLevel,
      levels = sort(unique(SMRLevel))
    )
  )

ggplot(
  rules_selected,
  aes(
    x = CMD_range,
    y = aSMR,
    colour = rSMR,
    group = rSMR
  )
) +
  geom_step(
    direction = "hv",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1200, by = 100)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 9, by = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, 1200),
    ylim = c(0, 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Climatic moisture deficit (CMD)",
    y = "Adjusted soil moisture regime (aSMR)",
    colour = "rSMR",
    title = paste(
      "Adjustment of relative soil moisture regime",
      "by climatic moisture deficit"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
